This application allows users to create, update, and view wiki entries, as well as view the edit history of each entry. The solution addresses the rendering of HTML content and ensures the application is runnable. app/controllers/application_controller.rb class ApplicationController < ActionController::API end app/controllers/entries_controller.rb class EntriesController < ApplicationController before_action :set_entry, only: [:show, :update, :history] # GET /entries def index @entries = Entry.all render json: @entries.map { |entry| { id: entry.id, title: entry.title, link: entry_url(entry) } } end # POST /entries def create @entry = Entry.new(entry_params) if @entry.save render json: @entry, status: :created else render json: @entry.errors, status: :unprocessable_entity end end # GET /entries/:id def show render plain: @entry.to_html, content_type: 'text/html' end # PUT /entries/:id def update if @entry.update(update_entry_params) render json: @entry else render json: @entry.errors, status: :unprocessable_entity end end # GET /entries/:id/edits def history render plain: @entry.edits_to_html, content_type: 'text/html' end private def set_entry @entry = Entry.find(params[:id]) rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound render json: { error: 'Entry not found' }, status: :not_found end def entry_params params.require(:entry).permit(:title, :content, :createdBy) end def update_entry_params params.require(:entry).permit(:content, :modifiedBy, :summary) end end app/models/application_record.rb class ApplicationRecord < ActiveRecord::Base self.abstract_class = true end app/models/entry.rb class Entry < ApplicationRecord has_many :edits, dependent: :destroy validates :title, presence: true validates :content, presence: true validates :createdBy, presence: true before_update :track_edit def to_html "

#{title}

#{content}

Last modified by: #{lastModifiedBy} at #{lastModifiedAt}

" end def edits_to_html edits.map do |edit| "

Edited by: #{edit.modifiedBy} - #{edit.summary}

Content: #{edit.content}

" end.join("
") end private def track_edit edits.create(content: content, modifiedBy: modifiedBy, summary: summary) end end app/models/edit.rb class Edit < ApplicationRecord belongs_to :entry validates :content,
